text:
3-stage build. Deps → Build → Runtime. Final image = Alpine + compiled JS only.

```dockerfile
# ── Stage 1: Install dependencies ──────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps

WORKDIR /app

# Copy manifests first — layer cache hit if unchanged
COPY package*.json ./

# Install ALL deps (need devDeps to compile)
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile

# ── Stage 2: Compile TypeScript ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder

WORKDIR /app

# Pull node_modules from deps stage
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .

RUN npm run build   # tsc → emits to /app/dist

# ── Stage 3: Runtime ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS runtime

ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app

COPY package*.json ./

# Prod deps only — no tsc, no ts-node, no types
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile --omit=dev && \
    npm cache clean --force

# Compiled output only — no .ts source
COPY --from=builder /app/dist ./dist

# Don't run as root
RUN addgroup -S appgroup && adduser -S appuser -G appgroup
USER appuser

EXPOSE 3000

CMD ["node", "dist/index.js"]
```

## What each decision buys

| Choice | Why |
|---|---|
| `node:20-alpine` | ~180MB vs ~1GB full image |
| 3 stages | Source + devDeps never reach runtime |
| `npm ci --frozen-lockfile` | Reproducible, faster than `install` |
| `--omit=dev` in runtime | Drops TypeScript, ts-node, type packages |
| `npm cache clean` | Removes download cache from layer |
| Non-root user | Security baseline |
| `COPY package*.json` before source | Layer cache: dep install skips if manifests unchanged |

## Assumed `tsconfig.json`

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "module": "commonjs",
    "target": "es2022",
    "strict": true
  },
  "include": ["src"]
}
```

## `package.json` build script need

```json
"scripts": {
  "build": "tsc --project tsconfig.json"
}
```

## Size check

```bash
docker build -t myapp .
docker images myapp   # expect ~150-200MB vs ~1.5GB naive single-stage
```

Adjust `dist/index.js` → match `outDir` + entrypoint in tsconfig.
